newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Japan's Tomen said vying for Philippine power deal.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Tomen said vying for Philippine power deal.

text.p: National Power Corp officials said on Friday a joint venture of the local Alsons Group and Japan's Tomen Corp of Japan was putting an offer to repair and maintain a 350-megawatt hydro power plant in the Philippines.

The Napocor official, who did not want to be quoted, said the Alsons-Tomen combine had bought bid documents and were expected to shortly submit a price and technical proposal for the Caliraya-Botocan-Kalayaan hydro power plant in Laguna, southern Philippines.
Last year, IMPSA Asia Ltd, a unit of Argentina-based Industries Metallurgica Pescarmona S.A. had put in an unsolicited proposal to repair and maintain the plant.
Under Philippine rules, Napocor could not accept an unsolicited bid and had to wait until there were competitors.
